items.title: “We Must Act Now”: 16 Nobel Laureates Issue Stark Warning About AI Job Threats
items.summary: Sixteen Nobel laureates just signed a letter that puts two of AI's most prominent skeptics in the same camp as Silicon Valley's biggest boosters, and the economists behind it say society may have only a few years to respond.
